messages:
alex_k: Quick sync — FinCloud flagged two blockers for our Private launch: (1) retention windows shorter than their policy, (2) mandatory BYOK with custodian escrow. Can product + security weigh tradeoffs?

maria_g: Thanks. They want a conservative default but ability to extend per-tenant. Key Q: do we ship per-tenant retention config in MVP or do we provide an export + long-term cold storage flow?

samir_p: My read — shipping per-tenant retention in MVP increases complexity (UI + RBAC + storage lifecycle). Export + archive pipeline is faster but means longer time-to-access for audits.

dana_security: From a compliance POV: audits often require immediate access to audit trails for 1+ years. Exports are fine if we guarantee immutability and chain-of-custody. Also BYOK escrow raises legal + operational questions (escrow custody, rotation, access procedures).

leo_pm: Proposal: MVP scope = (A) per-tenant retention override for logs/trace metadata with limits (min 30d default 90d max 365d) exposed as an admin toggle; (B) audit export pipeline to S3-compatible vaulted buckets with 365d retention; (C) BYOK support but escrow optional (legal sign-off required for escrow). Thoughts?

maria_g: I like the compromise. We should be explicit in launch criteria: admin toggle + API, audit export automated daily, export immutability + signed manifest, BYOK via KMS with manual escrow onboarding path.

alex_k: Adding suggested launch checklist (rough):
```
- Admin retention override UI + API endpoints implemented
- Tenant-level retention bounds enforced server-side (30-365 days)
- Daily audit export to Vaulted S3 with SHA256 manifests
- Export access logs + integrity proofs stored for 2 years
- BYOK via customer KMS (AWS/GCP/Azure) + optional escrow onboarding flow
- SOC2 control mapping doc updated (CC6, CC7 equivalents)
- E2E tests + regression evals for export correctness
- Legal sign-off on escrow process
```

samir_p: Implementation notes: server-side retention enforce = simple TTL lifecycle + policy layer. Export pipeline needs dedupe and resumable uploads for large tenants. BYOK: we can support KMS-encrypt-then-store; escrow requires HSM partner + SLA.

dana_security: Risk callouts: escrow introduces privileged access vectors. If escrow is optional, we must document that opting into escrow increases our legal exposure and requires separate contract addendum. Also include key rotation policy (recommend 90 days) and emergency access playbook.

leo_pm: Prioritization: label items as P0/P1 for sprint planning? My suggested split: P0 = retention override API + server enforcement, daily export pipeline, export immutability. P1 = UI polish, BYOK general (no escrow), SOC2 docs. P2 = escrow onboarding, rotated-key automation, extended retention >365. Agree?

maria_g: Agree. One ask from FinCloud: can we make export TTL configurable beyond 365 for enterprise contract? Mark that as sales-driven P1 with product + legal review.

infra_bot: Deploy note: feature-flag `enterprise-retention-controls` created on staging. CI job `export-pipeline-integration` queued.

alex_k: Next steps: 1) @maria_g draft launch criteria and acceptance tests, 2) @samir_p scope server-side enforcement + export pipeline tasks, 3) @dana_security draft escrow risk appendix and rotation playbook, 4) @leo_pm confirm prioritization in next planning ritual. Can everyone ack?

maria_g: Ack. I'll post acceptance test matrix by EOD Thursday. :white_check_mark:

samir_p: Ack — will drop an initial breakdown tomorrow morning.

dana_security: Ack. Will loop legal on escrow wording.

leo_pm: Ack. I'll put P0 items in the sprint board and tag SRE for capacity estimates.

alex_k: Cool — closing thread. If anything urgent from FinCloud, ping here and we'll escalate.
